title: Confession and Witness Again
author: Isandro Lockridge
blurb: Bram Sandoval, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has spent ten years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the statute expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
